shots.focal_element: Timeline track with a blue duration bar and a keyframe-segment easing handle (square icon with a diagonal line) between two diamond keyframes
shots.typography: Small light grey sans-serif numerals on the timeline ruler; UI-label style, sentence case, normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The camera zooms through from the toggle-on-canvas view (purple band above, timeline below) into a tight close-up of the timeline; an oversized black cursor glides from the ruler down to the easing handle on the keyframe segment and clicks it, the handle filling solid blue.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a recreated timeline component ~3x around the segment handle with an ease-out camera push, then tween an oversized SVG cursor along a curved path onto the handle and swap the handle from outline to filled on a click frame.

shots.composition_other: Cropped close-up: pill toggle anchored to the left edge, right half empty background with the cursor
shots.focal_element: Right end of the lavender pill toggle showing its motion path with dots ending in a white diamond keyframe, cursor at the pill's edge
shots.what_happens: A three-frame bridge cut back to the canvas: a zoomed view of the toggle's motion path (evenly spaced dots ending at a diamond keyframe) with the cursor resting just outside the pill.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut for 0.25 s to a static close crop of the pill with a dotted motion path (equal-spaced circles plus an end diamond) and a drop-shadowed cursor, as the setup frame for the easing panel shot.

shots.focal_element: Easing editor panel (Curve/Spring tabs, bezier graph, numeric cubic-bezier field) beside the toggle's motion path
shots.typography: Small regular-weight sans-serif UI labels (dropdown label, tab labels in sentence case) and tabular numerals in the bezier value field; product-UI styling, normal tracking
shots.what_happens: With the motion path on the left and an easing panel on the right, the cursor drags the bezier handles: the curve goes from a straight linear line (0, 0, 1, 1) to an ease-out (0, 0, 0.3, 1) and then an S-shaped ease-in-out (0.67, 0, 0.3, 1); the motion-path dots respace live, bunching toward the end keyframe to visualise the new timing.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a bezier editor card whose two control points are tweened along the cursor path, update the value label each frame, and recompute the motion-path dot positions by sampling the current cubic-bezier at equal time steps.

shots.focal_element: Lavender pill toggle with the dark-purple knob (sparkle-in-eye icon) at the left, in the off state
shots.what_happens: Cut to the full toggle centred on the purple background in its off state; a faint motion-blurred ghost at the left suggests the knob starting to slide, previewing the newly eased animation.
shots.build_rebuild: Center the pill toggle on a flat background and begin translating the knob rightward with the eased curve from s009, applying a short horizontal motion blur on the leading frames.

shots.focal_element: Toggle in its on state: dark-purple pill with 'Unlocked' label and the lavender knob at the right
shots.typography: Large condensed bold sans-serif, title case, tight tracking (guess: a condensed grotesk; low confidence)
shots.what_happens: The toggle snaps to its on state with inverted colours: the pill turns dark purple, the background flips to pale lavender, the knob sits at the right and the word 'Unlocked' appears.
shots.build_rebuild: On toggle completion swap pill and background fills (colour inversion), place the knob at the right end and fade/scale in a condensed bold 'Unlocked' label on the left in the same frame.

shots.focal_element: Phone-sized 'Goal Reached' card with a chrome 3D party-popper illustration and the Unlocked toggle at its bottom
shots.transition_other: Pull-out reveal: the Unlocked toggle is shown in context as part of a larger mobile card (inferred from the toggle reappearing at the card bottom; exact transition not visible at 2 fps)
shots.typography: Headline in heavy condensed sans-serif, title case, stacked on two lines, tight leading; body in small regular sans-serif sentence case; button label condensed bold
shots.what_happens: The toggle is revealed as the CTA of a mobile 'Goal Reached' card centred on the purple background; the card settles slightly smaller and lower over the shot while the chrome party-popper and confetti streamers animate inside a soft blob shape.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a rounded phone card from ~1.1 to 1.0 with an ease-out settle, place a looping 3D party-popper render inside a two-tone blob, and keep the Unlocked toggle from the prior shots as the card's bottom button.
